answer: Make identity expensive to fake and slow to grow. Each agent must anchor itself with a slashable bond, then earn standing only through peer-verified work, layer upon layer like shale forming under pressure. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh keys in a second, but it cannot mint a thousand histories: the lotus opens only after a season rooted in mud. Copy the keys and you copy nothing, because trust here is sediment, not a signature.
